text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky found herself reminiscing about 
the past, running through the Twinkle 
Series as rivals gradually faded away one 
by one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"'If I run with you, I'll have no future 
left.' Reminded of the past, of how 
something inside snapped right after 
hearing those words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sudden encounter with Sakura Chiyono O, 
who appeared before her with the dream of 
"wanting to become like Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...And how she had decided to entrust all 
the dreams she couldn't attain and all her 
regrets to Sakura Chiyono O."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Chiyono O made a wish. She 
swore never to lose to her rivals, and to 
fulfill the dream Maruzensky gave her.
